$comment: Structured task inventory for the agentic harness (docs/agentic/harness.md). Statuses: pending | in_progress | completed. Never mark completed without running the verification_steps; record outcomes in docs/agentic/progress.md.

features.description: Enforce canonical runtime policy: Python 3.11+, Node.js 22+ (24 LTS recommended) across docs, setup scripts, CI, and package.json engines.
features.user_value: New contributors and CI run on one consistent, supported toolchain; no setup failures from contradictory docs.
verification_steps: grep -rn -E 'Python 3\.10|Node(\.js)? 1[68]|Node(\.js)? 20' README.md AGENT.md CLAUDE.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs/user/ dev.ps1 dev.bat .github/ returns nothing
python3 scripts/docs_lint.py passes
CI frontend jobs run on node-version 22

features.description: dev.ps1 offers automatic Python 3.11 installation via winget (prompt defaults to Yes), refreshes PATH from registry, re-checks with the same detection function, and falls back to manual instructions on any failure.
features.user_value: Non-technical Windows users can go from zero to running app with one double-click even without Python installed.
verification_steps: PowerShell AST parse of dev.ps1 reports no errors
Manual: run dev.ps1 on a machine without Python and confirm the winget path, the [Y/n] prompt, and the fallback messages

features.description: Documented, repeatable agent loop: docs/agentic/{harness,evals,mcp-tools,roadmap,progress}.md plus this feature inventory, so any future agent session can resume from repo state alone.
features.user_value: Project demonstrates production agentic-engineering practice; work survives context resets and model changes.
verification_steps: All five docs/agentic files exist and pass python3 scripts/docs_lint.py
python3 scripts/generate_docs_index.py --check passes

features.description: Consolidated AI-safety policy doc (docs/compliance/ai-safety.md): refusal/escalation boundaries, grounding and citation requirements, uncertainty handling, emergency disclaimers, and pointers to the prompt-injection and PHI-leakage evals.
features.user_value: Reviewers and contributors see the non-diagnostic product boundary and how it is enforced in code and CI, not just claimed.
verification_steps: docs/compliance/ai-safety.md exists, is linked from docs/compliance/README.md, and every code/test path it cites resolves
python3 scripts/agent_eval_gate.py exits 0

features.description: Expand the adversarial eval set: dedicated prompt-injection corpus (instructions embedded in uploaded documents and memory items) and PHI-leakage probes on every export path, wired into scripts/agent_eval_gate.py or a sibling gate.
features.user_value: Injection and leakage resistance become regression-tested guarantees instead of one-time reviews.
verification_steps: New pytest cases (HC-XXX-NNN naming) fail when an injection succeeds or an export leaks unredacted text
Gate runs in CI and blocks merge on regression

features.description: Data-quality test suite and extraction eval card: labeled golden set of lab PDFs (synthetic), precision/recall on analyte, unit, date extraction; published as docs/agentic/eval-cards/extraction.md with versioned metrics.
features.user_value: Extraction accuracy is measured, tracked over time, and demonstrable — core Data Science portfolio evidence.
verification_steps: Golden-set pytest suite runs in CI with explicit thresholds
Eval card records metric, dataset version, and date for each run

features.description: Observability baseline: structured logging with request IDs across API routes, a /health endpoint check in e2e, and a local metrics summary (no external telemetry — local-first invariant).
features.user_value: Failures in real use are diagnosable from logs without violating the no-network guarantee.
verification_steps: pytest asserts request-ID propagation and audit-log coverage on document/observation/profile routes
e2e smoke hits /health

features.description: Packaged desktop distribution path (installer or bundled runtime) with signed release checklist, extending docs/agile/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md.
features.user_value: Real patients can install the app without a developer toolchain.
verification_steps: Documented build produces an artifact that boots on a clean Windows VM
Release checklist items each name a verifying command or manual step

features.description: Implement the local script tools from docs/agentic/mcp-tools.md (run_tests, run_lint, run_typecheck, run_e2e, check_docs_versions) as thin, credential-free wrappers; add read-only SQLite/SQLCipher inspection for synthetic dev vaults.
features.user_value: Agents verify work through narrow, auditable interfaces instead of ad-hoc shell, reducing risky tool calls.
verification_steps: Each wrapper exits nonzero on underlying failure (spot-check by injecting a failing test)
DB tool rejects write statements

features.description: Resolve the product name: 'HealthCentral' collides with an existing public health-media brand (healthcentral.com). Treat as internal codename; choose and clear a release name before any public distribution.
features.user_value: Avoids trademark risk before the project is shown publicly as a product.
verification_steps: Owner decision recorded in docs/agentic/progress.md
If renamed: grep for old name in user-facing strings returns only historical docs
